profiles.description: Daniel Toerpe attended the October 3, 2025 protest outside the Broadview immigration detention facility out of concern for immigrant neighbors. In a sworn declaration, he said Gregory Bovino and other federal agents pulled him to the ground and arrested him without warning. He was held inside the facility for several hours and released that afternoon without formal charges.
profiles.name: Daniel Toerpe

profiles.description: Esther Kleiman was a New York participant in a fur workers’ visit supporting the 1926 Passaic textile strike. Police arrested her during the July 25 demonstration in New Jersey. She was fined $25 for disturbing the peace. Contemporary union and Federated Press reports document the arrest and its labor context.
profiles.name: Esther Kleiman

profiles.description: Juan Muñoz is an Oak Park Township trustee who attended a protest at the Broadview immigration detention facility on October 3, 2025. In a sworn declaration, he said federal agents arrested him while he filmed the protest. He was held inside the facility and released that afternoon at a nearby gas station. His declaration described approximately eight hours in custody and the chilling effect of the arrest on his participation in protests.
profiles.name: Juan Muñoz

profiles.description: Scott Blackburn is an Oak Park resident and web developer who protested federal immigration enforcement at Broadview on October 3, 2025. His sworn declaration describes his arrest after criticizing Border Patrol commander Gregory Bovino. Video of the arrest was examined in federal court. He was detained at the Broadview facility and released that afternoon without formal charges.
profiles.name: Scott Blackburn
